verdict.credibility_line: Management overstates margin recovery and capex, but delivers strong top‑line growth, though guidance often exceeds actual performance.

promises.promise: Margin should bounce back in Q3 FY26 once revenues normalize and full benefit of the price hikes takes place.
promises.delivered: EBITDA margin was 12.9% in Sep 2025, down from 13.2% in Jun 2025.

promises.promise: Capex of about INR 750 cr for the switchgear business in FY26.
promises.delivered: Fixed assets+CWIP increased by 868 cr in FY26 (Mar 2026), ~16% above the INR 750 cr target.

promises.promise: FY27 capex of INR 748 cr for the greenfield switchgear plant.
Power Systems export revenue roughly doubling YoY.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Revenue growth remains above 25% YoY each quarter.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: YoY growth was 26% (Dec 2025), 25% (Mar 2026), 14% (Jun 2026), and 30% (Sep 2026) – the June quarter fell short.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: EBITDA margin is on a steady upward trend.
Capex spending aligns with the announced INR 748 cr for switchgear expansion.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Fixed‑asset growth in FY26 was 868 cr, about 16% above the INR 748 cr target, exceeding the 15% tolerance.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: The company maintains a low debt‑to‑equity ratio.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Debt‑to‑equity is 0.02, indicating very low leverage.

guidance_now: High‑teens revenue growth expected in the motor business.
Add ~45,000 MVA to power transformer capacity (from ~75,000 MVA).
EHV switchgear revenue contribution to arrive at least one year ahead of FY27‑FY28 schedule.
Power Systems export revenue projected to roughly double YoY.
Order book to rise to INR 17,333 cr (45% YoY), providing multi‑quarter visibility.
bull: Revenue surged 30% YoY in the Sep 2026 quarter, reaching ₹3,802 cr.
EBITDA margin peaked at 14.2% in Sep 2026, the highest of the year.
PAT rose to ₹409 cr in Sep 2026, a 44% YoY increase.
bear: Margin recovery missed in Sep 2025 Q3; EBITDA margin fell to 12.9% versus 13.2% in Jun 2025.
FY26 capex overshot the INR 750 cr target by about 16%, breaching the 15% tolerance.
Revenue growth slowed to 14% YoY in Jun 2026 quarter, below the 20%+ growth implied by guidance.
questions: What is the current completion status and expected commissioning date of the G2 semiconductor fab and the greenfield switchgear plant?
Can you provide a detailed breakdown of FY26 capex to confirm whether the INR 750 cr switchgear expansion target was met?
What assumptions underpin the forecast of Power Systems export revenue doubling YoY, and what risks could prevent achieving it?
